Privacy policy

How FormFit handles your images, what cookies are used for advertising, and the choices you have.

Your images never leave your device

This is the part that matters most, so it comes first. When you resize a photo or signature here, the work happens inside your own web browser using your device's processor. The image file is not uploaded to us. It is not transmitted over the network at all.

Because nothing is sent, there is nothing for us to store, nothing to delete on a schedule, and nothing that could be exposed if our hosting were ever compromised.

We therefore hold no photographs, no signatures, and no thumbprints belonging to anyone.

The upload kit, and what your own browser keeps

Most exam forms want more than one image, so the site keeps a short record of which ones you have finished and holds on to the resized files, letting you take them all away together later. That record and those files are written to your browser's local storage on your own device.

This is storage that belongs to your browser, not to us. The files stay on the device that made them, they are not transmitted anywhere, and we have no way to read them. Nobody using another device or another browser can see them either.

They are kept until you remove them. Clearing your browsing data for this site deletes both the record and the files. Browsing in a private or incognito window discards everything when the window closes.

The resized file being handed to you on the download page is held for the life of that browser tab and no longer.

What we do collect

Our host records standard server logs when a page is requested. These typically include an IP address, the page requested, a timestamp, and the browser's user agent string. They are used to keep the site running and to detect abuse.

We do not ask you to create an account, and we do not collect names, email addresses or phone numbers unless you choose to write to us.

Advertising and cookies

This site displays advertising supplied by Google AdSense.

Third party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to this site and other sites on the internet.

You can opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings at https://www.google.com/settings/ads. You may also opt out of a third party vendor's use of cookies for personalised advertising at https://www.aboutads.info/choices/.

Third party vendors and ad networks other than Google may also serve ads on this site. You can visit https://optout.networkadvertising.org/ to opt out of some of these vendors' use of cookies.

If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, you will be shown a consent notice before personalised advertising cookies are set, and you can change your choice at any time.

Analytics

We may use privacy-respecting analytics to count page views and understand which guides are useful. This does not identify you personally and is not combined with the advertising data described above.

Children

This site is a utility aimed at people filling in examination forms and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your choices

You can block or delete cookies through your browser settings. Doing so will not affect the resizer, because it does not depend on cookies to function. It may affect which advertisements you see.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes we will update the date shown at the bottom of this page. For any question about privacy, write to devkhushii08@gmail.com and we will respond.
